ollama._comment: screen_model: phi4-mini ~2.3GB, better instruction following than llama3.2 for Tier 1 batch classification. reason_model: qwen3:14b ~9GB, replaces mistral-small3.2 (15GB) for news filtering/routing/summarization — 6GB RAM savings. thinking mode disabled in kairos_ollama.py ask().

claude._comment: Claude Code CLI invoked via subprocess for Phase 2 reasoning. Set cli_path if claude is not on PATH.

slack._comment: Slack Bot API (slack_sdk). Values are channel IDs. kairos-alerts=C0AQA4ZH0P2, kairos-reports=C0AP9F2P10T, kairos-commands=C0APFSF09U2, kairos-log=C0APKEES12Q, kairos-trades=, kairos-watchlist= (was #new-channel).

options_signal._comment: HOT-OPTIONS thresholds. vol/OI spike, IV rank percentile, call/put skew. DTE range for front-month expiry selection.

confluence._comment: NLV-based conviction sizing. Tiers set position as % of Net Liquidation Value. Guardrails: 1% cash reserve (commissions + settlement), 25% sector max, 10% single position max.

tier0_filter._comment: Tier 0 pre-filter. All thresholds set to 0 — Finnhub profile API returning missing data for market_cap and avg_volume_30d, causing all 714 tickers to fail. Ollama Tier 1 handles quality filtering. Only min_price ($5) remains active to exclude penny stocks.

reallocation._comment: Reallocation parameters: minimum conviction scores, hold time guard, max loss threshold (-15% = block sells down >15%), max tax cost threshold ($1000), max thesis review age in hours, min remaining runway days, and signal hold windows.

hot_catalyst._comment: HOT-CATALYST long-options-only (buy calls/puts, never sell premium). dry_run=true simulates+logs all orders (override with dry_run=false AND --no-dry-run). Risk: 15% portfolio max in options, 2.5% NLV per position, 50% hard stop, 100% take-profit, close/roll at 21 DTE, no entry on earnings day, 30-60 DTE preferred at entry. Delta bands: default 30-40 (Setup1 pre-catalyst), reversion 40-50 (Setup2 post-crush), flow 25-35 (Setup3 unusual flow). Setup1: enter 7-21d before catalyst when iv_rank<=0.50 (underpriced vol). Setup2: trigger on >=10% drop over <=3 days; thesis-driven direction (reclaim/hold gap low=intact->calls, lower lows=broken->puts). Setup3: follow unusual flow only if no earnings within 5 days.
